paper_title: Auditing Exact-Repetition Containment in Multi-Speaker Transcription
version_note: Base evidence mappings below refer to the original tmm_revision_v003 snapshot. The additive token 4-gram experiment from tmm_revision_v013 is mapped in addenda; baseline artifacts retain their historical identities.
metric: cpCER is a fraction, lower is better; an empty hypothesis has cpCER 1.0.

claims.verification: All 42 printed cpCER values (seven interventions across six evaluation cells) exactly match the released CSV rounded to four decimals.

historical_figures: figures/historical_v043 contains earlier content-free SVGs; the two top-level PDFs belong to the base v003 manuscript. The added n-gram figure is mapped in addenda.
reproducibility_boundary: The released numeric tables support independent aggregation and consistency checks, and the method code supports reproduction on locally authorized inputs. End-to-end rerunning of the private S-FULLTAC arm remains unavailable; public Sortformer and Whisper weights must be obtained separately. This release does not independently validate the original audio or listening judgments.
